method: Actual CommonJS game/support with collision-aware movement, visibility, damage and construction. Focused support simulations retain living enemy bases but hold enemy attacks and reinforcements still; this is not a campaign balance or GPU/device test.

checks.name: Six real arrivals are required; unarrived recruits cannot trigger departure
Full guard quota and existing tank do not block automatic assault production
Recruitment uses eight-second cadence, six with reserve, and a separate 24-unit cap
An assembled assault physically reaches and damages a living enemy portal compound
A destroyed objective is retargeted to the nearest surviving portal
All portals destroyed stops recruitment and returns survivors to a central reserve
Workers repair only after physically reaching a visible service point, at six HP per second
Workers repair a factory and tank inside the base without healing infantry, dead or outside units
Line of sight blocks repair even when a worker is already at the service point
Pause and open terminal freeze repair, replacement and production; workers replace for free after 20 seconds
Fortification increases maximum and current health by exactly the same amount, including at full health
A destroyed and rebuilt bunker retains site fortification plus armor after real construction completes
